naive_n.pseudo_replication_note: Arms A and B are deterministic given the curve; the 5 seed replicates within each (p,b) group repeat the identical A/B values 5x. This naive pooled statistic is INVALID for C_A, C_B, R_A, R_B due to pseudo-replication and is reported for transparency only, exactly as EV-ECDLP-65b004 / DEC-20260808-6a7ac4 require. Arm D varies by seed but is still nested within (p,b) groups, not independent draws. Design called for 8 independent (p,b) groups; only 4 were REACHED before the frozen early-exit stopping rule triggered (see early_exit). The label 'corrected_n8_groups' names the STATISTICAL METHODOLOGY from specification.yaml's replication discipline (group-mean correction for A/B pseudo-replication), not a claim that 8 groups were observed -- the actual n is in the 'n' field alongside every statistic below.
